title: Listing Highlight: 45' Tiara Yachts F44 Flybridge 2019
description: Discover the 2019 Tiara Yachts F44 Flybridge, a 45-foot coastal cruiser combining elegant design with practical cruising capability for discerning owners.
html:
A Well-Appointed Flybridge Motor Yacht Built For Modern Boating

The 2019 Tiara Yachts F44 Flybridge represents a refined approach to mid-sized motor yacht design, offering the comfort and capability that appeals to experienced boaters seeking a versatile platform for coastal exploration and extended cruising. Built by Tiara Yachts, a manufacturer known for quality construction and thoughtful layouts, this 45-foot flybridge model balances performance with livability in a package that works equally well for weekend getaways or longer voyages.

The flybridge design is central to this vessel's appeal, providing an elevated helm station with commanding sightlines and an expansive outdoor entertaining area. The upper deck layout maximizes social space while maintaining excellent visibility for navigation, a hallmark of Tiara's design philosophy. Below, the main saloon flows naturally from the galley forward, creating an intuitive living space that feels open despite the vessel's moderate length. Cabin accommodations include a full master suite with ensuite facilities, guest staterooms, and crew quarters, making this model suitable for families or those who entertain regularly. The galley is well-equipped for extended cruising, with modern appliances and ample storage. The main saloon features comfortable seating and large windows that flood the interior with natural light, while the flybridge helm offers dual helm seats and comprehensive instrumentation for confident operation.

Power comes from twin diesel engines that deliver reliable performance and reasonable fuel efficiency for a vessel of this size. The twin-screw configuration provides excellent maneuverability and redundancy, important considerations for anyone planning extended offshore passages. Fuel capacity and range are well-suited to coastal cruising and island hopping, with the ability to transit between major cruising grounds without excessive refueling stops. The hull design reflects Tiara's commitment to seaworthiness, with a moderate deadrise that provides a comfortable ride in typical cruising conditions while maintaining stability at rest. The keel configuration offers good tracking and directional stability, qualities that matter when piloting long distances or navigating challenging anchorages.

Key Specifications: 🛥️ Length: 45 feet

🛥️ Year: 2019

🛥️ Flybridge with dual helm seating and full instrumentation

🛥️ Twin diesel engines with proven reliability Main Characteristics: ⚓ Spacious flybridge entertaining and helm area

⚓ Modern galley equipped for extended cruising

⚓ Excellent sightlines and natural lighting throughout

Whether you are planning to explore hidden coves along the coast or entertain friends and family in style, the 2019 Tiara Yachts F44 Flybridge delivers the combination of comfort, capability, and quality construction that discerning boaters demand.
